title: Task body
description: The task body that the sender sends: type, goal, parameters and attachments. The body permits nothing: everything that permissions and delivery depend on (tenant, initiator, origin, conversation, tier, data class, untrusted_seen, budget, address) the core writes into the task record, and the schema rejects any extra field (IDN-1, TEN-2). The params field is open here: the task type params_schema closes it (INJ-1). The body is stored as content of the class content (RET-1).

type.description: Task type with the version .vN, for example ops.investigate.v1; the core carries it into the task record. It is set by channel code, a schedule, a route or an external program, not by the model (IDN-6).

goal.description: Goal in plain language. The only free field; it permits nothing.

params.description: Parameters by the closed schema params_schema of the task type; the core fills in defaults and checks them at enqueue (INJ-1). At most 32 fields, as for the arguments of request_action and P3 tools/call.

attachments.description: Up to 10 attachments: file_ref, text or data. Attachments have no url links (INJ-8). An attachment sets untrusted_seen on the task (INJ-13).

media_type.description: Content type named by the sender, for reference; the core determines the file type from the bytes (the same pattern as in P1 file.put).

data.description: JSON data as an object of at most 64 fields; for the model this is untrusted data.
data.x-botaru-closed-by: result_schema of the source task or the schema of the plugin that produced the data
